lead.hed: USNI: Navy unveiled Malice at Tailhook. A 250-mile claim is not a magazine.
lead.insight: USNI Monday 13:54 EDT, from the authorized RSS file — the article page 403’d this turn: the Navy is developing a long-range missile the service says can down aerial targets out to 250 nautical miles. USNI writes the designation AIM-242 and says the service revealed Malice over the weekend at the Tailhook Association symposium. Navy file photos posted Saturday on DVIDS label the same class AIM-424 LRAAM — four rounds on an F/A-18E for a test event. A range claim is not inventory. A file photo is not a loadout. A designation split is not a fielding order.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy file photo · DVIDS 9879419 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · Four AIM-424 LRAAM loaded on an F/A-18E Super Hornet for a test event. Date taken April 3, 2026; posted Aug. 22, 2026. Caption must say test load / file photo, not today’s Tailhook podium.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of four AIM-424 LRAAM on an F/A-18E Super Hornet for a test event. Same-subject class as the Monday Malice file — not a Bulgaria tanker, not a Lincoln launch, not a brand tile. Same-turn CDN JPEG 200 / local 194691 / 1000×667.

political.hed: SOUTHCOM: two killed on an Eastern Pacific boat. A strike is not a cleared sea.
political.insight: Official U.S. Southern Command release, dated Aug. 23 and readable this turn: under Gen. Francis L. Donovan, Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere executed a lethal kinetic strike on a low-profile vessel on established narco-trafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific. SOUTHCOM says confirmed intelligence showed the vessel’s active involvement and that the operation killed two narco-terrorists. A command statement is not a court. Two dead is not a theater closed. USNI’s Monday file is the same event; this rail cites the command release, not the 403’d writeup.

political.hed: Law & Liberty: Gorsuch’s Slaughter concurrence. Overruling Humphrey’s is not the last word.
political.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: in Trump v. Slaughter the Court held the president may remove the FTC’s head because the commission exercises executive power. Roberts’s majority overrules Humphrey’s Executor. Gorsuch’s lone concurrence says the leftover problem is the other half of the bargain — agencies still hold legislative and judicial power, now under the president. A concurrence is not a holding. A holding is not a statute.

political.hed: Defense News: two U.S. tankers left Bulgaria. A Friday exit is not a closed war.
political.insight: Defense News Monday 08:44, retired off the AM lead: two U.S. Air Force KC-135s left Bulgaria’s Bezmer air base Friday, Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov told reporters. Parliament approved the temporary deployment July 22. Iran called it complicity; Sofia dismissed the charge. A departure is not a basing deal. A minister’s quote is not a Pentagon order. Malice is the Monday PM clock.

tech.hed: Defense News: Italy is eyeing APKWS for drones. An FMS approval is not a buy.
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday from Rome: the Italian Air Force is weighing U.S. APKWS II kits that turn cheap unguided rockets into laser-guided drone killers. State approved an FMS of 5,031 kits plus launchers, warheads, motors, and support — a $364 million potential package. Italian sources told Defense News no contract is signed and the kit is still being evaluated, likely for Eurofighter. The RAF already fielded it. An approval is not inventory. A Baltic shoot-down is not an Italian buy.

tech.hed: Defense News: Patria signed a Finland drone LOI. A letter is not a factory.
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday: Finnish Patria and Ukraine’s General Cherry signed a Sunday letter of intent to jointly develop unmanned systems and start drone production in Finland. Patria did not say which models or when the line opens. Cherry says its FPV and interceptor drones are already with more than 200 Ukrainian units. An LOI is not a plant. A statement is not a delivery.

culture.hed: WORLD: Smith’s luminous dark. Mystical unknowing is not the gospel.
culture.insight: WORLD, Thursday, still the weekday culture rail: James K.A. Smith’s new Yale book asks readers to dwell in mystical non-knowing after a midlife crisis. The review’s point: union with God is through the knowable Mediator, not a cloud that erases revelation. A mood is not a creed. Certainty about Christ is not pride.

watch.hed: WATCH: Lincoln is still in 7th Fleet. A Saturday transit is not today’s lead.
watch.insight: USNI Saturday file, retired off the Monday AM political rail: Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) left the Middle East after almost seven months and is in U.S. 7th Fleet. As of Saturday, Lincoln, escorts, and Carrier Air Wing 9 were in the Indian Ocean under INDOPACOM. A transit is not San Diego. The Monday PM clock is Malice.
